title: Devonish Scones
description: Light plain scones made with Greek yogurt instead of butter, ideal for afternoon tea with jam.
steps: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl; add yogurt and vanilla extract; mix with a metal spoon then knead briefly into a dough. Rest 10 minutes.
Roll out on floured surface to ~1cm thick; cut out 11 rounds with a 5cm fluted cutter.
Place on lined baking tray; brush tops with beaten egg.
Bake on middle shelf 10–12 minutes until risen and golden.
notes: For cheese scones: omit sugar and vanilla, add 40g grated mature Cheddar. Serve with Easy Chia Seed Summer Fruit Jam (p.25).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
